Your Start at Porsche Engineering
Porsche Engineering: Pioneering and Accelerating Technologies for Vehicles and Beyond
At Porsche Engineering, we are committed to develop pioneering digital and engineering solutions. Since 1931, we have been crafting the technologies of the future for vehicles and beyond.
Explore news, insights, and innovations in our Newsroom—your source for updates on Porsche Engineering’s journey in shaping future mobility and engineering solutions.
Porsche Engineering celebrates 25 Years of Engineering Excellence and Innovation in the Czech Republic

Porsche Engineering Czech Republic, the Czech branch of the international technology service provider Porsche Engineering, celebrates its 25th anniversary in 2026. Since its foundation in Prague in 2001, the company has developed from a small engineering office into one of Porsche Engineering’s largest development locations and an important part of its international development network.
Porsche Engineering and Porsche Digital Combine their Expertise under the Brand Porsche Technologies

The international engineering services provider Porsche Engineering and the digital and software unit Porsche Digital will combine their expertise under the joint brand Porsche Technologies. This creates an integrated provider of holistic end-to-end technology solutions. The service offering is aimed at Porsche, the automotive industry, as well as other industrial and technology sectors.
Frauscher x Porsche 790 Spectre Surpasses the 50-Knot Mark

The Frauscher x Porsche 790 Spectre electric sports boat, jointly developed by Porsche and Austrian boatbuilder Frauscher, has set a new speed record at the Monaco Energy Boat Challenge. With an average speed of 51.05 knots (94.5 km/h), the boat broke the symbolic 50-knot barrier for the first time and set a new competition record.
